definitions: The act or practice of employing automated software programs (bots) to perform tasks, often repeatedly, on the internet or within other systems.
The application of robotic processes or algorithms to automate functions, frequently in contexts like customer service, data collection, or social media interaction.
examples: The company faced criticism for its extensive use of bots to manipulate online reviews.
Researchers are studying the ethical implications of the widespread use of bots in political campaigns.
Efficient customer support often involves the strategic use of bots to handle common queries.
